paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ATL-0013 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Country profile: Vanir SOURCE_NAME: Realm Trade Ministry SOURCE_TYPE: atlas RELIABILITY: 1 PUB_DATE: 2024-01-15 PUB_TIME: 09:45 COUNTRY: Vanir SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Country profile: Vanir

[P1] Vanir is the largest rice exporter in the region and a significant wheat producer. Its economy is more agricultural than those of the eastern industrial states, though it also has food processing and light manufacturing.

[P2] The country's main exports are rice and wheat. It imports fuel and fertiliser, both of which are important for its farming sector. Vanir Rice Port is the main export facility, with bulk handling and bagging lines.

[P3] Rune Trading, a grain and rice trader, is the best-known firm in the sector. The country has a long coastline and several smaller loading points, but Vanir Rice Port handles the largest share of its rice shipments.
[P4] Rice is grown in the wet lowlands, while wheat is more common on higher ground. The port has storage silos and bagging lines, and a rail spur connects it to the main inland towns.
